name: codex-handoff
description: Continue a Codex task in a Sailbox and return its synchronized result to the originating task.

interface.shortDescription: Hand a task to a sandbox and collect its result.
interface.longDescription: With explicit consent, forwards Codex authentication to a private Sailbox, completes the task there, synchronizes changed files, and returns the report to the originating task.
defaultPrompt: Hand off my current task to a configured sandbox
